thread:
Emma (CS): Quick heads-up — Acme reserved pool priming tomorrow 10:00 PST. Need final quota numbers, autoscale policy, and a load-test owner. Can people confirm?
Raj (OPS): Ops will run the scale job. Requested quota = 2500 rps peak, target sustained 1800 rps. Reserve 4x A100s for 2h window.
Lina SRE: let's avoid a single spike. Recommend three warmup waves to let caches populate: start + 60m + 120m.
Matt Eng: I can own the load script + metrics. Will use k6 + prometheus. I’ll push scripts to repo and tag.
Julie (Acme): 2500 rps sounds right from our side. note: we have a maintenance blackout 11:00-11:30 PST, so avoid that window.
Raj (OPS): ack blackout. updated windows: 10:00, 12:00, 14:00 PST. Autoscale policy proposal: scale_up_threshold=75%, cool_down=90s, scale_down_threshold=40%, target_util=65%. Thoughts?
Emma (CS): also need billing/quota flag: please create reserve id Q-ACME-0426 and CC finance for preapproval. @finance_team — FYI.
DeployBot: reserved capacity allocated: pool_id=rp-7788, nodes=4xA100, allocation_window=2h, owner=Acme. (provisioning in progress) :rocket:
Lina SRE: KV cache priming plan: 1) 30m prefix-replay at low concurrency, 2) staggered traffic to 20% hot-cache fill, 3) abort criteria: p95 model latency > 350ms or error_rate > 1%.
Matt Eng: load command (example):
```
k6 run --vus 400 --duration 30m acme_priming.js\```
Matt Eng: metrics we'll watch: p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, GPU util, mem headroom, error_rate, OOMs. Alert if GPU util > 95% for 5m.
Julie (Acme): we'll provide 10k sample prompts and a traffic mix CSV (60% short, 30% mid, 10% long). Sending the file to Emma now.
Emma (CS): risks: if we fail to hit capacity with SLOs this quarter, renewal could be impacted. Post-test retro scheduled 16:00 PST same day — ops + customer + eng required.
Raj (OPS): runbook draft: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/acme-reserved-priming — includes rollback steps and canary fallback to hosted-small.
Raj (OPS): quick checklist copy here: - quota id verified - nodes provisioned - KMS access confirmed - logging hooks enabled - canary fallback configured - oncall pager assigned
Lina SRE: who has KMS key confirmation? Julie?
Julie (Acme): KMS keys already shared with redwood-prod account, alias acme-prod-kms. Confirmed.
Matt Eng: pushed load scripts + perf thresholds: git.redwood/internal/loads/acme-priming, branch=acme-priming-2026. Thresholds in README.
Emma (CS): perfect. please react with :white_check_mark: when each checklist item is done. I’ll compile a short status note to the account owner and AM.
Julie (Acme): thanks all — looking forward to the run.
Raj (OPS): will post final readiness ping 30m before start.
Lina SRE: leaving a note — if we see token-level regressions, switch to model-variant v1.2-quant and re-run warmup at half-concurrency.
Emma (CS): noted. closing loop: post results to the thread and add to the customer onboarding folder. :wave:
